reading.body:
EdgeConneX operates three separate facilities in the Portland market under a single ambiguous registry entry, with disclosed capacities ranging from 18,700 square feet of raised floor space to planned power draws up to 21 MW, but this record cannot be matched to a specific building.

The three Portland buildings, identified by the operator as POR01, POR02, and POR03, carry different published specifications. POR02 is planned for 3 MW initially, scaling to 6 MW with redundancy across two data halls. POR03 is planned for up to 21 MW. No power figure is published for POR01, which has 18,700 square feet of raised floor. The operator's own location page does not provide street addresses for any of the three facilities, and their coordinates in this record do not resolve to a specific building among them.

All three facilities hold certifications for SOC 2 Type 2, PCI DSS, HIPAA, and ISO 27001 compliance at the market level. The operator, founded in 2009 and acquired by EQT Infrastructure in 2020, operates over 90 data centers globally. This registry cannot assign power or square footage figures to this entry without confirming which Portland building it represents, so none are attributed here. The ambiguity prevents tracking whether this site is built, planned, or represents capacity in flux.
